svg.title: The largest planned run remains held at the stated date
svg.desc: Keep the largest planned run behind an explicit held state at the stated date. Avoid a resume arrow or an implied universal training shutdown. Visual distinction: A bounded workload tray with a large pause pair and a stop bar. A temporary operational disposition, not a breached wall or permanent destruction.
